title: Tess Dislikes a Bath
lines: Our cat Tess got mud on her legs.
She had been out in the wet grass.
Raj said Tess had to have a bath.
But Tess dislikes a bath a lot.
She hid under the bed all day long.
Raj got the tub and the soap set up.
Then he went to lift Tess out.
Tess hissed. Tess and Raj disagree!
Raj sat and had a think about it.
Then he got a bit of fish from Mom.
He held it up by the tub.
Tess came out to get the fish.
Raj gave her the fish and a wash.
Tess likes fish. She still dislikes a bath.

questions.ask: Why did Tess have to have a bath?
questions.listenFor: She got mud on her legs out in the wet grass.

questions.ask: What happened when Raj went to lift Tess out from under the bed?
questions.listenFor: Tess hissed. That is when the story says they disagree.

questions.ask: Do you think Tess will hide again next bath day? Why?
questions.listenFor: The story does not say, so both are right. You want the reason.
